connectors.name: 12-pin connector (lower-right board view)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers printed and no USB connector visible in that view; vertical row started at the top. A small dot below the bottom GND pin is not a labeled pin-1 mark.

uncertain: Board identity: the lower-right board in the image is silkscreened 'ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-2.8C 480x480 Pixels', while the record is ESP32-S3-LCD-2.8C (no 'Touch'); the upper-left view carries no product name.

The image shows two board views; it is assumed both are the same product. The 12-pin connector's order used the top rule because its view shows no USB connector; if the dot below the last GND pin marks pin 1, the order would be reversed.
I2C/UART 4-pin connector order assumes the USB-C receptacle labeled 'UART' counts as the USB connector for the closest-end rule.
notes: Waveshare connector callout graphic. Callouts give GPIO numbers (e.g. SCL(GPIO7)); silkscreen spellings kept in functions. Buttons (BOOT, RST), BAT and ON switch skipped.
